_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for LIVI on the S52 480×640 portrait panel. Merged into ~/.config/LIVI/config.json by scripts/s52-apply-livi-config.sh. Keys starting with _ are docs only.
_projection: Stream resolution sent to the phone (portrait, after HDMI rotate). Match react-carplay: scripts/s52-carplay-config.json.
_mainScreen: LIVI window/compositor output size — separate from stream resolution in v7+, but both must match our panel for kiosk.
_dpi: 220 matches react-carplay; bump toward 240 if UI still feels small.
_mediaDelay: Audio buffer in ms. Higher = fewer dropouts, more latency. 4000 for skip testing; scale back if tolerable.
